[P2] Synchronize losing steps with map completion

The map cannot complete until item 0's result checkpoint returns. If that checkpoint takes longer than 200 ms, items 1–3 enqueue their `SUCCEED` updates before the ancestor is marked finished. Those updates are accepted rather than dropped, producing additional `StepSucceeded` events that fail the new test's exact history assertion even with a correct SDK. This affects cloud integration, where checkpoint latency is uncontrolled. Replace the fixed sleep with an invocation-local promise gate released after `await context.map(...)`, so losing steps always submit their results after abandonment.
